rows.grounds: compound of laghu (light) and ṣoḍhā; feminine nominative singular form
compound of mahā (great) and ṣoḍhā; feminine nominative singular form
neuter nominative singular of dvitaya, denoting a twofold set
vocative singular address to the supreme goddess

items.question: Which two shodha forms are paired and addressed to the supreme goddess?
premises: laghuṣoḍhā and mahāṣoḍhā form a pair
the pair is addressed to parameśvari
the verse names both shodha forms together
items.inference: The verse presents the light-shodha and great-shodha as a paired set for the supreme goddess.
uncertainties: the exact ritual sense of ṣoḍhā is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: The light-shodha and great-shodha are a pair, O supreme goddess.
